article.story: RALEIGH, N.C. -- — Pyotr Kochetkov’s 26-save shutout gave him 10 straight victories to begin the season, Sean Walker scored two goals, and the Carolina Hurricanes beat the Winnipeg Jets 7-0 on Sunday. Kochetkov became the third goalie in NHL history to start a season at 10-0. Sebastian Aho, Juuso Valimaki, Logan Stankoven, Mark Jankowski and Jesperi Kotkaniemi also scored for the Hurricanes, who’ve won four in a row. Stankoven, Seth Jarvis, Nikolaj Ehlers and Shayne Gostisbehere all had two assists. Kochetkov tied Carey Price’s 10-win mark with Montreal from 10 years ago for the second-longest season-opening streak. Only Jack Campbell holds a longer season-beginning mark with 11 consecutive victories for the Toronto Maple Leafs in 2020-21. Kochetkov’s second shutout of the season pushed his career total to 13 in 135 games. The Jets have lost nine games in a row (0-7-2). Stuart Skinner, who made 12 saves, was pulled after allowing the fifth goal. Clay Stevenson stopped 13 shots in relief. Walker’s short-handed goal began the scoring 5:16 into the game. Aho’s power-play tally came during Carolina’s four-goal spree in the first 10 minutes of the second period. Stankoven’s goal at 9:09 of the second period stretched the lead to 5-0. At the time, the Jets had five total shots on goal. It’s Walker’s his first two-goal output in two seasons with the Hurricanes. Winnipeg has allowed 23 goals in its past four games. Up next Jets: Tuesday night at Montreal to end a four-game road trip. Hurricanes: at Nashville on Tuesday night. ------ AP NHL: https://apnews.com/hub/nhl
